items.title: Tesla stops selling solar roofs a decade after launch

items.title: Why Tesla (TSLA) Is Up 6.9% After Robotaxi Approvals And 500 Semi Deal News - And What's Next
items.summary: Earlier this month, Einride AB announced plans to deploy 500 Tesla Semis on its Saga AI freight platform over the next 24 months across major U.S. freight corridors, while regulators in Nevada and Texas approved Tesla to operate thousands of Cybercab robotaxis following its recently scheduled September 3 Austin launch event. Together, these moves highlight Tesla’s push to pair autonomous trucking and ride-hailing with its software platforms, potentially deepening recurring revenue...
